title: a full constructor body sees the default and may replace it
purpose: Defaults are bound before the body of a full constructor runs.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision, 19.10.2026 (D-035, refined): before the constructor runs, every defaulted field is filled with its default; the constructor then binds the supplied values, replacing defaults; finally every field must be bound, otherwise construction fails. The default (10) is evaluated first, the body reads it and rebinds n to 10 + 5 = 15.
